name: Fortune Five
description: An Alloy on the Seametry Hall. One share is a fixed Formula of five tokenized stocks: AAPLx, MSFTx, NVDAx and GOOGLx from xStocks, and SPCX from Backpack Securities, equal in value at the founding quote and never rebalanced. Any wallet can Strike it or Melt it; no one can stop a Melt. On devnet the constituents are stand-ins carrying each issuer's token settings.

attributes.value: Equal value at the founding quote
